definitions.explanation: The act of moving from one residence to another. A formal term commonly used in official documents and administrative contexts.

examples.japanese: {転居|てんきょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{届|とど}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
⟦{転居先|てんきょさき}→転居先：29866_tenkyosaki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me your new address.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧⟦に{伴|ともな}い→に伴い：06804_nitomonai⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧{転居|てんきょ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことになった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{郵便局|ゆうびんきょく}→郵便局：00579_yuubinkyoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{転居届|てんきょとどけ}→転居届：10284_tenkyotodoke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}さ→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: I'll be moving next month due to a job transfer, so I need to submit a change-of-address form at the post office.

notes:
USAGE: {転居|てんきょ} is a formal word used mainly in official documents, government forms, and written communication. In everyday conversation, {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し or ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧ is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{転居届|てんきょとどけ}→転居届：10284_tenkyotodoke⟧: change-of-address notification
- ⟦{転居先|てんきょさき}→転居先：29866_tenkyosaki⟧: new address (after moving)
- {転居|てんきょ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to move, to relocate
- {転居|てんきょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧: moving announcement

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {転居|てんきょ}: formal term for changing residence
- {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し: moving (everyday term)
- ⟦{移転|いてん}→移転：04000_iten⟧: relocation (used for both residences and businesses/offices)
